_doc: Staged, reversible move of Ultrastable assets from the QNFO (quniverse) account to the dedicated Ultrastable account. The source is never deleted by this plan; deletion is a later, separate item after a soak period. Driven by scripts/cf_account.py.

not_moved.demo-child-ultrastable: demo tenant; redeployed by its own bootstrap

stages.do: cf_account.py inventory <source> and <target>; write the result to deploy/transfer/inventory-*.json
cf_account.py transfer copy --apply: D1 export/import, KV, worker code with bindings remapped; crons off on target
stages.exit: state.stage = copied; secret names listed for re-binding

stages.do: cf_account.py transfer verify: workers present, D1 row counts equal per table; then GET /health on the target worker
cf_account.py transfer cutover --apply: enable crons on target first, then remove from source (never zero hosts)
stages.exit: a tick row written on the target within 15 minutes

stages.do: cf_account.py transfer rollback --apply: crons back to source, removed from target; nothing deleted
stages.exit: a tick row written on the source within 15 minutes

stages.do: after 7 days of clean ticks on the target, file an item to retire source copies
stages.exit: item filed with owner and probe

manual_after_cutover: custom domains (ultrastable.io/.app/.net) are zone-bound: move the zone or re-attach the routes in the zone's account
re-bind worker secrets by name from the repo secret store (values are never read from Cloudflare)

progress.stage: 2-copy partly done: worker code on the target (byte-identical, crons off); data copy is stale (2026-11-12) and must be re-taken at cutover

blockers.what: an API token for the target, bound as the GitHub secrets and as CF_DEPLOY_TOKEN; without it deploys after cutover still go to the old account
tick CREDENTIAL_KEY and GITHUB_REPOS, site CF_ACCOUNT_ID and CF_DEPLOY_TOKEN cannot be read back from Cloudflare
ultrastable.io/.app/.net/.org are zones of the old account; custom domains and send_email need them in the target
blockers.who: owner (DNS and zone moves are human-gated)

blockers.what: R2 not enabled on the target (error 10042); enabling accepts terms in the dashboard
scripts/cf_account.py copy uploads multi-module workers as one worker.js, ignores service-binding order, never refreshes a non-empty target D1

cutover_order: doctrine/topology.json account_id and store ids switched in one PR
target crons on, source crons off (cf_account.py transfer cutover)
zones moved, custom domains and send_email re-attached
